name: A1 - Facebook Business Page Enricher via Apify-v1

parameters.content:
## A1 Facebook Business Page Enricher

Optional batch enrichment for records missing contact fields. Uses apify/facebook-search-scraper with categories, one canonical location, and a bounded total result limit.

Default trigger: at least two of phone, email, external website are missing. Override with facebook_missing_field_threshold (1..3).

Only confidently matched public business Pages can fill empty fields. Facebook Page URLs remain separate from official website candidates. Person names are never inferred. Parent source status, cursor, and exhaustion are preserved.

parameters.query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS a1_facebook_enrichment_jobs (
  run_id text NOT NULL,
  source_job_id text NOT NULL,
  request_key text NOT NULL,
  actor_run_id text,
  dataset_id text,
  actor_status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING',
  job_status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING',
  actor_input jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
  usage_total_usd numeric,
  last_error jsonb,
  started_at timestamptz,
  finished_at timestamptz,
  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  PRIMARY KEY (run_id, source_job_id, request_key)
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS a1_facebook_enrichment_active_idx ON a1_facebook_enrichment_jobs(actor_status, updated_at DESC);
SELECT 1 AS schema_ready;

WITH request AS (SELECT $1::text run_id,$2::text source_job_id,$3::text request_key,$4::jsonb request_payload), policy AS (SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE actor_status IN ('READY','RUNNING','TIMING-OUT','ABORTING') AND NOT (run_id=$1 AND source_job_id=$2 AND request_key=$3))::integer active_other_runs FROM a1_facebook_enrichment_jobs) SELECT request.request_payload,(job.run_id IS NOT NULL) existing_job_found,job.actor_run_id,job.dataset_id,job.actor_status,job.job_status,job.usage_total_usd,job.last_error,policy.active_other_runs FROM request CROSS JOIN policy LEFT JOIN a1_facebook_enrichment_jobs job ON job.run_id=request.run_id AND job.source_job_id=request.source_job_id AND job.request_key=request.request_key;

parameters.jsCode: const row=$json||{};const request=row.request_payload||{};const status=String(row.actor_status||'').toUpperCase();const active=new Set(['READY','RUNNING','TIMING-OUT','ABORTING']);const succeeded=status==='SUCCEEDED'&&Boolean(row.dataset_id);const resumable=Boolean(row.actor_run_id)&&(active.has(status)||succeeded);let error=null;if(Number(row.active_other_runs||0)>0&&!resumable)error={code:'FACEBOOK_CONCURRENCY_LIMIT',message:'Another Facebook enrichment Actor is active.',retryable:true,stage:'policy'};else if(row.actor_run_id&&!resumable)error={code:'FACEBOOK_EXISTING_JOB_NOT_RESUMABLE',message:`Existing Facebook Actor state ${status||'UNKNOWN'} is not automatically restartable.`,retryable:false,stage:'policy'};return [{json:{...request,existing_job_found:Boolean(row.existing_job_found),actor_run_id:row.actor_run_id||null,dataset_id:row.dataset_id||null,actor_status:status||null,job_status:row.job_status||null,usage_total_usd:row.usage_total_usd??null,resume_existing:resumable,policy_allows_new_run:!error&&!row.actor_run_id,policy_block_error:error,actor_started_this_execution:false,poll_deadline_at:new Date(Date.now()+20*60*1000).toISOString()}}];

const c=$('Decide Facebook Start or Resume').item.json;const run=$json||{};const msg=run.error?String(run.error?.message||run.error):'';const ok=Boolean(run.id)&&!msg;return [{json:{...c,actor_start_ok:ok,actor_run_id:ok?run.id:null,dataset_id:ok?(run.defaultDatasetId||null):null,actor_status:ok?String(run.status||'READY').toUpperCase():'START_FAILED',job_status:ok?'RUNNING':'FAILED',actor_started_this_execution:ok,actor_error:ok?null:{code:'FACEBOOK_ACTOR_START_FAILED',message:msg||'Apify returned no Actor run ID.',retryable:true,stage:'actor_start'},poll_deadline_at:new Date(Date.now()+20*60*1000).toISOString()}}];

parameters.query: INSERT INTO a1_facebook_enrichment_jobs(run_id,source_job_id,request_key,actor_run_id,dataset_id,actor_status,job_status,actor_input,started_at,updated_at) VALUES($1,$2,$3,$4,$5,$6,$7,$8::jsonb,now(),now()) ON CONFLICT(run_id,source_job_id,request_key) DO UPDATE SET actor_run_id=EXCLUDED.actor_run_id,dataset_id=EXCLUDED.dataset_id,actor_status=EXCLUDED.actor_status,job_status=EXCLUDED.job_status,actor_input=EXCLUDED.actor_input,last_error=NULL,started_at=COALESCE(a1_facebook_enrichment_jobs.started_at,now()),updated_at=now() RETURNING *,$9::jsonb AS request_payload;

parameters.jsCode: const row=$json||{};const request=row.request_payload||row;if(!request.actor_run_id)throw new Error('actor_run_id is required for Facebook polling.');return [{json:{...request,actor_run_id:row.actor_run_id||request.actor_run_id,dataset_id:row.dataset_id||request.dataset_id||null,actor_status:String(row.actor_status||request.actor_status||'READY').toUpperCase(),job_status:row.job_status||request.job_status||'RUNNING',poll_deadline_at:request.poll_deadline_at||new Date(Date.now()+20*60*1000).toISOString()}}];

const c=$('Prepare Facebook Poll State').item.json;const run=$json||{};const responseError=run.error?String(run.error?.message||run.error):'';const previous=String(c.actor_status||'UNKNOWN').toUpperCase();const status=responseError?previous:String(run.status||'UNKNOWN').toUpperCase();const active=new Set(['READY','RUNNING','TIMING-OUT','ABORTING']);const deadline=Date.now()>=Date.parse(c.poll_deadline_at);let error=null;if(responseError)error={code:'FACEBOOK_ACTOR_STATUS_FAILED',message:responseError,retryable:true,stage:'actor_poll'};else if(deadline&&active.has(status))error={code:'FACEBOOK_POLL_DEADLINE_EXCEEDED',message:'Facebook Actor did not finish before the deadline.',retryable:true,stage:'actor_poll'};else if(!active.has(status)&&status!=='SUCCEEDED')error={code:'FACEBOOK_ACTOR_TERMINAL_FAILURE',message:`Facebook Actor ended with ${status}.`,retryable:status!=='ABORTED',stage:'actor_run'};return [{json:{...c,actor_run_id:run.id||c.actor_run_id,dataset_id:run.defaultDatasetId||c.dataset_id||null,actor_status:status,job_status:error?'FAILED':status==='SUCCEEDED'?'SUCCEEDED':'RUNNING',usage_total_usd:run.usageTotalUsd??c.usage_total_usd??null,actor_error:error,continue_polling:active.has(status)&&!deadline&&!responseError}}];

const c=$('Prepare Facebook Enrichment Batch').first().json;const rows=$input.all().map(i=>i.json||{}).filter(r=>!r.error&&Object.keys(r).length);const records=c.prepared_records.map(r=>({...r}));function text(v){return v==null?'':String(v).normalize('NFKC').trim().replace(/\s+/g,' ')}function norm(v){return text(v).toLowerCase().normalize('NFKD').replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g,'').replace(/\b(llc|inc|ltd|company|co|corp)\b/g,' ').replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g,' ').trim().replace(/\s+/g,' ')}function digits(v){return text(v).replace(/\D/g,'')}function mail(v){return text(v).toLowerCase()}function domain(v){let x=text(v);if(!x)return'';if(!/^https?:\/\//i.test(x))x='https://'+x;try{return new URL(x).hostname.toLowerCase().replace(/^www\./,'')}catch{return''}}function pageUrl(r){const u=text(r.pageUrl||r.facebookUrl);return /^https?:\/\/(?:www\.)?facebook\.com\//i.test(u)?u:null}function externalWebsite(v){let x=text(v);if(!x)return null;if(!/^https?:\/\//i.test(x))x='https://'+x;try{const u=new URL(x);if(!['http:','https:'].includes(u.protocol)||/^(www\.)?facebook\.com$/i.test(u.hostname))return null;return u.toString()}catch{return null}}function validEmail(v){const x=text(v);return /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(x)?x:null}function validPhone(v){const x=text(v);const d=digits(x);return d.length>=7&&d.length<=15?x:null}const used=new Set();let verified=0,ambiguous=0,notFound=0;for(const cand of c.facebook_candidates){const scored=[];for(const r of rows){const url=pageUrl(r);if(!url)continue;const rid=text(r.pageId||r.facebookId||url);if(used.has(rid))continue;const title=text(r.title||r.pageName).split('|')[0].trim();const n1=norm(cand.business_name),n2=norm(title);const exact=Boolean(n1&&n1===n2);const contains=Boolean(n1&&n2&&(n1.includes(n2)||n2.includes(n1)));const hay=norm([r.title,r.address,...(Array.isArray(r.info)?r.info:[])].join(' '));const regionMatch=!cand.region&&!cand.region_code?true:Boolean((cand.region&&hay.includes(norm(cand.region)))||(cand.region_code&&hay.includes(norm(cand.region_code))));const location=Boolean(cand.city&&hay.includes(norm(cand.city))&&regionMatch);const contact=Boolean((cand.phone&&digits(cand.phone)===digits(r.phone))||(cand.email&&mail(cand.email)===mail(r.email))||(cand.website&&domain(cand.website)===domain(r.website)));const score=(exact?60:contains?35:0)+(location?25:0)+(contact?50:0);if(score>=80&&exact&&(location||contact))scored.push({r,url,rid,title,score,location,contact});}scored.sort((a,b)=>b.score-a.score||a.url.localeCompare(b.url));const target=records[cand.record_index];if(!scored.length){target.facebook_enrichment={schema_version:'a1.facebook-business-enrichment.v1',status:'not_found',missing_fields_before:cand.missing_fields,filled_fields:[],checked_at:new Date().toISOString()};notFound++;continue}if(scored.length>1&&scored[0].score-scored[1].score<15){target.facebook_enrichment={schema_version:'a1.facebook-business-enrichment.v1',status:'possible_match',missing_fields_before:cand.missing_fields,filled_fields:[],candidate_page_urls:scored.slice(0,3).map(x=>x.url),requires_human_review:true,checked_at:new Date().toISOString()};ambiguous++;continue}const best=scored[0];used.add(best.rid);const filled=[];const evidence=[{field:'facebook_page_identity',excerpt:best.title,source_url:best.url}];if(!validPhone(target.phone)){const v=validPhone(best.r.phone);if(v){target.phone=v;filled.push('phone');evidence.push({field:'phone',excerpt:v,source_url:best.url})}}if(!validEmail(target.email)){const v=validEmail(best.r.email);if(v){target.email=v;filled.push('email');evidence.push({field:'email',excerpt:v,source_url:best.url})}}if(!externalWebsite(target.website)){const v=externalWebsite(best.r.website);if(v){target.website=v;filled.push('website_candidate');evidence.push({field:'website_candidate',excerpt:text(best.r.website),source_url:best.url})}}target.facebook_page_url=best.url;target.facebook_enrichment={schema_version:'a1.facebook-business-enrichment.v1',status:'verified',page_id:best.rid,facebook_page_url:best.url,missing_fields_before:cand.missing_fields,filled_fields:filled,match_score:best.score,identity_basis:{exact_business_name:true,location_match:best.location,contact_match:best.contact},evidence,provider:'apify',actor:'apify/facebook-search-scraper',checked_at:new Date().toISOString()};target.source_notes=[...(Array.isArray(target.source_notes)?target.source_notes:[]),'Public Facebook business Page used only as supplemental evidence; any external website remains an unverified candidate.'];verified++;}return [{json:{...c,final_records:records,facebook_batch_status:'completed',facebook_actor_run_id:$('Evaluate Facebook Actor').first().json.actor_run_id,facebook_dataset_id:$('Evaluate Facebook Actor').first().json.dataset_id,facebook_error:null,facebook_counts:{eligible:c.facebook_candidates.length,verified,ambiguous,not_found:notFound,raw_results:rows.length}}}];

parameters.query: UPDATE a1_facebook_enrichment_jobs SET actor_status='SUCCEEDED',job_status='COMPLETED',usage_total_usd=$4,last_error=NULL,finished_at=now(),updated_at=now() WHERE run_id=$1 AND source_job_id=$2 AND request_key=$3 RETURNING *,$5::jsonb AS normalized_payload;

INSERT INTO a1_facebook_enrichment_jobs(run_id,source_job_id,request_key,actor_run_id,dataset_id,actor_status,job_status,actor_input,last_error,started_at,finished_at,updated_at) VALUES($1,$2,$3,$4,$5,$6,'FAILED',$7::jsonb,$8::jsonb,now(),now(),now()) ON CONFLICT(run_id,source_job_id,request_key) DO UPDATE SET actor_run_id=COALESCE(EXCLUDED.actor_run_id,a1_facebook_enrichment_jobs.actor_run_id),dataset_id=COALESCE(EXCLUDED.dataset_id,a1_facebook_enrichment_jobs.dataset_id),actor_status=EXCLUDED.actor_status,job_status='FAILED',last_error=EXCLUDED.last_error,finished_at=now(),updated_at=now() RETURNING *,$9::jsonb AS failure_payload;

parameters.jsCode: const c=$('Prepare Facebook Enrichment Batch').first().json;const src=$json||{};const err=src.actor_error||src.policy_block_error||{code:'FACEBOOK_ENRICHMENT_FAILED',message:'Facebook enrichment failed.',retryable:false,stage:'facebook_enrichment'};const eligible=new Set(c.facebook_candidates.map(x=>x.record_index));const records=c.prepared_records.map((r,i)=>eligible.has(i)?{...r,facebook_enrichment:{schema_version:'a1.facebook-business-enrichment.v1',status:'failed',missing_fields_before:r.facebook_enrichment?.missing_fields_before||[],filled_fields:[],checked_at:new Date().toISOString(),error:err}}:{...r});return [{json:{...c,final_records:records,facebook_batch_status:'failed',facebook_actor_run_id:src.actor_run_id||null,facebook_dataset_id:src.dataset_id||null,facebook_error:err,facebook_counts:{eligible:c.facebook_candidates.length,verified:0,ambiguous:0,not_found:0,raw_results:0}}}];

const c=$json;const envelope=c.source_envelope||{};const records=Array.isArray(c.final_records)?c.final_records:c.prepared_records||[];const out={...envelope};if(Array.isArray(envelope.records))out.records=records;if(Array.isArray(envelope.parsed_records))out.parsed_records=records;if(!Array.isArray(envelope.records)&&!Array.isArray(envelope.parsed_records))out.records=records;const warnings=[...(Array.isArray(envelope.warnings)?envelope.warnings:[])];if(c.facebook_batch_status==='failed')warnings.push(`Optional Facebook enrichment failed: ${c.facebook_error?.code||'unknown_error'}. Original source records were retained.`);out.warnings=[...new Set(warnings)];if(Array.isArray(envelope.parser_warnings))out.parser_warnings=[...new Set([...envelope.parser_warnings,...warnings])];out.facebook_enrichment={schema_version:'a1.facebook-enrichment-batch.v1',status:c.facebook_batch_status,actor_run_id:c.facebook_actor_run_id||null,dataset_id:c.facebook_dataset_id||null,request_key:c.facebook_request_key,counts:c.facebook_counts||{eligible:c.facebook_candidates?.length||0,verified:0,ambiguous:0,not_found:0,raw_results:0},error:c.facebook_error||null,finished_at:new Date().toISOString()};return [{json:out}];
